"description":"AgingBooth, one of the most popular iPhone & iPad apps still FREE on the App Store!

What will you look like when you’re old? And what about your friends? Find out with AgingBooth, an easy to use and amazing face aging machine on your iPhone & iPad. AgingBooth is a funny (or scary!) way to instantly age face photos. Use AgingBooth on family, friends or colleagues photos and share them via email, iMessage, Instagram, Snapchat, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp…

Ready to face your future?

Tips
• Shake device to switch before and after views 
• More Effects: combine with another effect from your "Booth Collection"

Features
• Works with photos taken with your built-in camera or from your photo library 
• Auto-cropping using face detection
• Transformation process is instant with no internet connection needed
• Scroll results into the app gallery 
• Save results to your photo library 
• Share with your friends via email, iMessage, Instagram, Snapchat, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp…

By the creators of FatBooth, MixBooth, BaldBooth, UglyBooth, BoothStache & BimboBooth.

Warning:
• AgingBooth is a funny application made for entertainment purposes only and does not guarantee resemblance to the real aging process.
• AgingBooth works best with people between the ages of 15 and 60.
